product_overview: Family Wealth Manager is a web application to centralize personal and family financial management—providing dashboards, transaction management, budgeting, recurring expense tracking and net worth monitoring in a responsive UI.
core_goals: Centralize financial data (transactions, budgets, recurring expenses, assets/liabilities) in one secure place.
Provide clear, actionable insights on spending vs budgets and overall net worth.
Enable fast CRUD operations for transactions, recurring items, budgets and patrimony while maintaining data integrity and validation.
Deliver a responsive, secure experience with quick dashboard metrics and graceful error handling when backend resources are unavailable.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Secure user authentication and account creation using Supabase Auth, with form validation and clear error messages for invalid credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Click "Entrar na Conta" to login -> Redirect to / -> See dashboard with KPIs
Navigate to /login -> Click "Criar Conta" to register -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Click "Criar Conta" -> See welcome or confirmation -> Redirect to /
Navigate to /login -> Fill email field with incorrect password -> Fill password field -> Click "Entrar na Conta" to login -> See error message for invalid credentials
Navigate to /login -> Leave email or password empty -> Click "Entrar na Conta" to login -> See inline validation errors preventing submit

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Overview page showing available balance, total income, total expenses, expense distribution by category, recent transactions and quick actions like adding a transaction.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See "Capital Disponível" (Balance) -> See "Entradas Totais" (Income) -> See "Saídas & Consumo" (Expenses) -> See Expense Pie Chart by category -> See Recent Transactions list -> Click "Nova Transação" to open add dialog
Navigate to / -> Click a recent transaction -> See transaction detail or edit controls (if available) -> Return to dashboard
Navigate to / -> Backend DB views not available or server action fails -> See empty or error state for KPIs -> See suggested retry message or contact support
Navigate to / -> Slow network -> Metrics load spinner displays -> After timeout, show error banner indicating metrics unavailable

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Full management of financial transactions: list, filter by period, add new entries, update details and delete incorrect records with validation on required fields and values.
user_flows: Navigate to /transacoes -> See transactions list -> Click filter control -> Select month and year -> See filtered transactions

Navigate to /transacoes -> Click "Nova Transação" to open add dialog -> Fill Description field -> Fill Value field with positive number -> Select Category -> Select Type -> Select Date -> Fill Responsible -> Click Save -> See new transaction in list
Navigate to /transacoes -> Click a transaction's delete control -> Confirm deletion -> See transaction removed from list
Navigate to /transacoes -> Click "Nova Transação" to open add dialog -> Leave Value field empty or enter zero/negative -> Click Save -> See inline validation error preventing save
Navigate to /transacoes -> Attempt to update a transaction -> Fill fields -> Click Save -> Server action fails -> See error message and transaction remains unchanged

features.name: Recurring Expenses
features.description: Manage subscriptions and fixed recurring bills: list active recurrents, create new recurring items, toggle active/inactive status and delete them.
user_flows: Navigate to /recorrentes -> See list of recurring items with status -> Click Add Recurring -> Fill Description field -> Fill Value field -> Select Due Date / Frequency -> Click Save -> See new recurring item in list
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Locate a recurring item -> Click toggle active status -> See status update reflected in list
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Click delete on an item -> Confirm deletion -> See item removed from list
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Click Add Recurring -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Save -> See inline validation errors and creation prevented
Navigate to /recorrentes -> Perform toggle or delete -> Server action fails -> See error notification and previous state remains

features.name: Budgeting
features.description: Define monthly spending limits per category, view progress vs actual spend with visual indicators and delete budget limits when no longer needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /orcamentos -> See budget status vs actual spending (progress bars per category) -> Identify categories nearing limit
Navigate to /orcamentos -> Click create new budget limit -> Select Category -> Fill monthly limit value -> Click Save -> See new budget line and progress bar
Navigate to /orcamentos -> Click delete on a budget limit -> Confirm deletion -> See budget removed and progress updates
Navigate to /orcamentos -> Click create new budget limit -> Leave Category or Limit empty or set zero -> Click Save -> See validation error preventing creation
Navigate to /orcamentos -> Attempt to edit an existing budget item -> Observe edit functionality missing -> See instruction or tooltip to delete and recreate item

features.name: Net Worth Tracking
features.description: Track assets and liabilities to compute net worth, allowing users to add and remove items and view the aggregated net worth over time.
user_flows: Navigate to /patrimonio -> See list of assets and liabilities and current net worth calculation -> Review totals

Navigate to /patrimonio -> Click Add Item -> Fill Item name -> Fill Value with positive number -> Select Type (Asset or Passive) -> Select Category -> Click Save -> See new item in list and net worth updated
Navigate to /patrimonio -> Click delete on an item -> Confirm deletion -> See item removed and net worth recalculated
Navigate to /patrimonio -> Click an existing item to edit -> Observe edit functionality missing -> See instruction to delete and recreate item to apply changes
Navigate to /patrimonio -> Add item -> Server action fails -> See error notification and item not added

tech_stack.other: Supabase, Zod, React Hook Form, Recharts, Framer Motion
